name: GDQuest Make Pro 2D Games A-RPG
description: Complete open A-RPG reference project with interlocking gameplay, inventory, shop, UI, save/load and boss systems. Valuable as architecture/system reference; built for an older Godot generation.

licence.notice: Repository contains an MIT licence and describes the project as MIT-licensed. Preserve the MIT notice. Exact art/audio/content provenance should still be audited before copying bundled production content rather than using the project as code/architecture reference.

provenance.notes: Official GDQuest demo repository with MIT licence. Treat source code/architecture as the strongest reuse case; bundled visual/audio content still deserves exact-item provenance review before commercial adoption.

maintenance.evidence: Repository remains public but latest code commit is from the Godot 3.x era; it is a stable historical reference rather than a current production starter.
maintenance.notes: Do not adopt wholesale into a current Godot 4.x project without migration-cost evidence.

compatibility.notes: Current pipeline projects using Godot 4.x should mine system/architecture patterns selectively and measure migration cost.

risk.legalNotes: MIT repository licence is clear; bundled art/audio/content should be audited independently before commercial copying. Course branding/content should not be represented as By JTT work.
risk.securityNotes: Old-engine reference code can contain outdated APIs/patterns; port selectively and review saves/file I/O and current platform requirements.

assessment.notes: Strong whole-game/reference source for inventories, shops, menus, saves and gameplay composition; unlikely to win as a wholesale modern starter due to Godot-version age.

evidence.notes: Official GDQuest A-RPG demo repository; README describes multiple interlocking game systems and MIT source availability.

publication.notes: Publish primarily as a whole-game architecture/reference source with explicit Godot 3 age and asset-provenance caveats.
